description: This file is a shell script used for testing git fetch-pack and fetch operations, including various scenarios such as shallow clones, negotiation protocols, filtering objects, and protocol diagnostics.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified name and message, updating the corresponding branch reference.

methods.name: pull_to_client
methods.description: Fetches specified references from the server into the client repository, verifying pack objects and reference updates.

methods.name: check_prot_path
methods.description: Verifies protocol diag URL parsing for a given URL, protocol, and path.

methods.name: check_prot_host_port_path
methods.description: Verifies protocol diag URL parsing with host, port, and path components.

methods.name: fetch_filter_blob_limit_zero
methods.description: Test fetching with object filter 'blob:limit=0' over different protocols and URLs.
